literal: "I" [and] "mine" which says pride he who severs, celestials-to higher world will enter.
translation: He who severs the pride that says "I" and "mine" will enter a world higher than that of the celestials.
modern: 'நான்', 'என்னுடையது' என்று சொல்லும் அகந்தையை வேரறுப்பவன், தேவர்களுக்கும் மேலான உயர்ந்த உலகத்தை அடைவான்.
explanation: This couplet identifies the core of true renunciation as the elimination of ego and possessiveness. The words 'யான்' (I) and 'எனது' (mine) represent the root causes of worldly attachment. 'செருக்கு' denotes the arrogant delusion that arises from clinging to these two concepts. By completely severing ('அறுப்பான்') this pride, a person achieves a spiritual state or realm ('உலகம்') that surpasses even the heavens of the celestial beings ('வானோர்க்கு உயர்ந்த').
